title: Minimize window to the Dock

properties.notes: Fades out over the last 60 % of the duration.
Genie target scale, not a fixed pixel size: the window must reach the Dock tile it animates to.
Motion path, not an interpolated number: implementation-dependent but must converge on the tile.

interruption.expected_result_when_interrupted: Interrupting by clicking the Dock item mid-flight continues to the un-minimized end state from the current position; the window never snaps or disappears.

observed_source.notes: Mavericks genie duration is documented around 0.3-0.4 s. It was NOT measured here: the reference guest runs under TCG without isochronous frames (UI_REFERENCE rule C2), and the guest desktop was never reached.

gtk3.notes: Client-side animation of the toplevel is not possible under X11 without compositor cooperation.

compositor.notes: xfwm4 has no minimize effect; a genie/suck effect requires a compositor with per-window effects (picom-class) or a custom compositor.

fallback.what: Cross-fade + scale to the Dock tile corner
fallback.reason: xfwm4 cannot warp the window surface; documented compromise, see docs/DECISIONS.md

gaps.what: real measured duration and curve of the minimize effect
gaps.issue: requires a desktop capture round in the reference guest (frame timestamps of screendumps, not TCG frame counts)

gaps.what: which MavLinOS compositor can realize a warp-style minimize
gaps.issue: xfwm4 (baseline, low power) has no such effect; choosing picom-class compositing would change the frozen power baseline and needs an explicit experiment

notes: This record is the contract: whatever the platform does, it must be expressible as these properties and this interruption policy.
